data.assumption: “Use the most” means the count of successful non-test payment attempts by method for non-test orders in Madurai stores, across all available dates.
data.sql:
SELECT pa.method, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN cities c ON c.city_id = s.city_id
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND pa.status = 'succeeded'
  AND c.name = 'Madurai'
GROUP BY pa.method
ORDER BY value DESC
